headline: New York Times sues Brave browser over AI scraping, paywall bypass
summary: The New York Times and other publications filed suit against Brave, accusing the browser maker of unlawfully scraping their content to train AI and of letting users bypass paywalls. One report adds that the scraped content was allegedly redistributed to Brave's own customers, including Anthropic and Perplexity.

claims.statement: The New York Times and other publications sued Brave over alleged unlawful scraping of their content.

sources.quote: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls

claims.statement: The lawsuit also accuses Brave of letting users bypass the publications' paywalls.
